title: Kestrel
tagline: The mountain keeps its own map.
synopsis: Surveyor Ada Venn joins pilot Elias Kade to chart a remote pass above the town of Calder. When a landslide strands their crew, Ada must choose between completing the survey and guiding a rival expedition to safety.

title: The Orchard Lease
synopsis: In coastal Valmera, teacher Lina Cho inherits a failing pear orchard from an uncle she barely knew. A seasonal worker offers to keep it alive, but the deed names a buyer who arrives before the fruit is ripe.

title: Blackwater Signal
synopsis: Radio engineer Yeri Han hears a distress call from a lighthouse that has been dark for nine years. She takes a ferry to Blackwater Island, where a retired keeper insists the voice belongs to his dead brother.

title: Sunday at Mero
synopsis: At her grandmother's café in Mero, Priya Shah promises four feuding cousins the same job running the annual fair. Her improvised auditions turn the village upside down just as a food critic arrives unannounced.

title: Tin Bird Summer
synopsis: In a sleepy river town, Mika Sato builds a mechanical bird from discarded clock parts and discovers it repeats tomorrow's sounds. She and her brother must decide whether to warn the town about a storm no forecaster believes is coming.

title: Copper Line
synopsis: Transit inspector Vera Illich finds a smuggling route hidden inside the copper wiring of a new subway line in Bracken. Her partner Malik wants an arrest, but Vera suspects the depot chief is protecting a witness.

title: Salt on the Wind
synopsis: At North Haven, salt farmer Elka Sabo teaches Mara, Rafael, and Owen to harvest the tidal beds after a storm leaves their families without work. The children discover that a proposed seawall would bury the channels their village depends on.

title: Ashfall Station
synopsis: A remote weather station receives measurements from a volcanic eruption that has not happened yet. Technician Laila Bako traces the readings to a damaged satellite while a minister orders the data buried to prevent an evacuation panic.

title: Ghosts of the Viaduct
synopsis: After inheriting a boardinghouse beneath the Bellwether viaduct, Mara Velez hears a train cross the bridge each night although its tracks were removed decades ago. A tenant disappears after following the sound into a sealed service tunnel.

title: The Glass Coronet
tagline: A crown can be a prison.
synopsis: In the divided city of Ardenne, court artisan Isabel Vale is ordered to repair a ceremonial crown before the young regent's first public address. She discovers the jewels are replicas and must find who sold the originals before blame falls on her apprentice.

title: The Midnight Rehearsal
synopsis: A touring brass band misses its ferry and persuades a shuttered theater in Rensby to host one last show. Singer Yuna Bell must keep the musicians together while the theater's owner quietly negotiates its demolition.

title: Paper Moon Fox
synopsis: When the moon vanishes over the village of Lyst, young Elin folds a fox from her grandfather's letters. The creature comes alive and leads her through forgotten stories, but every fold erases a memory she wants to keep.

title: Lantern Bay
synopsis: At Lantern Bay, teenage Anika Mehta discovers that the island's lighthouse will be sold after its keeper falls ill. She recruits a ferry mechanic and a retired surveyor to prove the beacon still protects the fishing fleet.

title: La Dernière Carte
synopsis: Cartographer Alma Ríos returns to her childhood home in Marseille after a warehouse fire exposes a hidden street on an old city map. Her father denies the street existed, even as former residents begin to receive letters from it.

title: Canyon of Ashes
synopsis: Rancher Nadia Farouk rides into the dry settlement of Corva to recover horses stolen during a survey dispute. She learns the new boundary puts the town's only well under the control of the man who hired the thieves.

title: The Ferry Battalion
synopsis: During a winter retreat, nurse Binta Sarr commandeers a civilian ferry to evacuate wounded soldiers from Loma Harbor. A delayed order demands she return for military cargo, leaving the crew to decide whose lives count as essential.

title: Riverboat Ruse
synopsis: Celeste Marin sells tickets to a supposedly luxurious river cruise that turns out to be a produce barge. When a jewel courier boards by mistake, she must keep her passengers entertained while deciding whether to return his missing case.

title: The Ninth Door
synopsis: Restorer Maeve Quinn counts eight doors in the empty Bellamy Hotel until a ninth appears after midnight. Inside she finds objects from guests who vanished decades earlier, and the concierge warns that returning one will invite its owner back.

title: Violet Inventory
synopsis: Museum registrar Leila Haddad discovers that every object in a small Paris collection has been mislabeled by a lovesick former curator. She asks visiting conservator Wei Chen for help, then finds his own family history threaded through the catalog.

title: Harbor of Keys
synopsis: After a locksmith dies in Port Lune, his daughter Camille inherits a wall of unclaimed keys and a ledger with no addresses. She follows one key to a boarded school and uncovers why her father stopped speaking to the town's mayor.

title: Havets Tavshed
tagline: The sea kept a second log.
synopsis: Dispatcher Marta Voss finds a passenger name added to the manifest after the ferry is sealed for winter in Aarhus. The harbor office calls it a clerical mistake, but a child's mitten appears in a cabin nobody rented.

title: Summer Horn Section
synopsis: Gina Ferraro takes over her uncle's struggling town band just weeks before the Brindle summer parade. She recruits a bus driver, two rival students, and a mechanic whose trumpet has not been played in twenty years.

title: Starling Run
tagline: One ship can outrun a system.
synopsis: Freight pilot Samira Rahman discovers that the navigation beacons around Port Oris have been secretly redirected to strand refugee vessels. She steals a fast courier called Starling and races to broadcast the true coordinates before the patrol fleet closes in.

title: Desert Postmark
tagline: The letter took the long road.
synopsis: In the dry town of San Oriel, postal clerk Talia Reed receives a love letter addressed to a woman buried thirty years earlier. She rides with a reluctant guide to find the sender and learns the dead woman's daughter has been waiting for an answer.

title: Second Floor Snow
synopsis: Apartment caretaker Aisha Mir tries to conceal a burst pipe before her building's fussy owner arrives for inspection. As snow falls inside the upstairs ballroom, the tenants turn the disaster into an unauthorized winter festival.

title: Wake of the North
synopsis: Marine biologist Elise Laurent boards a research cutter near Sable Point to retrieve a sensor trapped beneath pack ice. When the ship's captain refuses to turn back from a dangerous channel, she discovers he is following a signal from his missing son.

title: Ink House
synopsis: Ada Mensah takes a cheap room above a print shop in Fenwick and wakes to find yesterday's conversations typed across the wallpaper. The messages begin changing before anyone speaks, warning her that the landlord plans to lock the building at dawn.

title: Clockwork Pier
synopsis: In a harbor built on giant gears, apprentice Elin must restart the pier clock before the spring tide leaves every fishing boat stranded. A stubborn sea gull knows where the missing brass key went, but demands a favor first.

title: Broken Census
tagline: A missing column changed a city.
synopsis: Historian Salma Idrissi examines the 1942 census of Westbridge, where an entire neighborhood disappeared from the official count. Residents and archivists piece together how a property scheme used that omission to deny families their homes.

title: Bellweather Kitchen
synopsis: When a critic mistakes Clara Weiss's retirement home for a new restaurant, she and cook Alma Ruiz decide to serve him anyway. Their improvised menu becomes a local sensation, threatening the quiet routine the residents had finally earned.

title: The Alder Trial
synopsis: Public defender Iris Bell takes a murder case in Alder County after the only eyewitness changes her account three times. A forgotten bus ticket points to a second passenger who could clear her client, if she can find him before sentencing.

title: La Casa Vacía
synopsis: Eszter Nagy arrives in the hill village of Aranda to sell her sister's vacant house. Each morning the furniture returns to its old arrangement, and a local mason admits he has been hearing her sister sing through the walls.

title: The Marble Violin
synopsis: Cellist Jo Park finds an unfinished concerto tucked inside a damaged instrument at the Cavan conservatory. She asks an aloof pianist to help perform it, then learns the score was abandoned during a public feud between their grandparents.

title: Kestrel: White Ridge
tagline: The second route has a price.
synopsis: Eight years after opening Calder Pass, Ada Venn returns to guide a rescue across White Ridge when a new tunnel collapses. Pilot Elias Kade is flying for the mining company that ignored her warnings, forcing old allies to trust each other under fire.

title: Thorn and Tide
tagline: The garden grew toward the sea.
synopsis: Gardener Lina Cho is hired to restore a walled estate on the island of Merrow, where every plant blooms only at night. Her young assistant finds a path that appears with the tide, and Lina must decide whether to reveal it to the estate's impatient owner.

title: Iron Parade
synopsis: In wartime Brenna, field medic Nari Choi joins a civilian convoy carrying replacement machine parts to a besieged hospital. The officer assigned to protect them receives orders to seize the cargo for an armored unit, and the drivers refuse to unload.

title: Bamui Jido
tagline: A map waited for its owner.
synopsis: In Seoul, archivist Jiyun is asked to identify a hand-drawn map found in a demolished music hall. Every address marks a place where a pianist once met a stranger, including a café owned by the man who claims not to know her.

title: Blue Hour Dam
synopsis: Engineer Hana Mori notices that the floodgates at Eastmere Dam open seconds before their control signals arrive. She traces the anomaly to a buried communications array while a festival downstream leaves thousands in the spillway.

title: Sparrow Court
synopsis: At Sparrow Court, tenants Zora and Samira form a fake homeowners' board to stop a developer from buying their building. Their forged notices become so effective that a real city inspector asks them to investigate a missing maintenance fund.

title: Copper Line: Night Switch
synopsis: Inspector Vera Illich is drawn back to Bracken's subway when a witness from the original copper case vanishes during a scheduled power cut. Malik Noor finds the same hidden wiring route has been repurposed to move evidence out of police storage.

title: Last Light Library
synopsis: Laila Bako volunteers at a library scheduled to close in the hill town of Orin. After sundown, unfinished stories step out of their bindings, and she has one week to help the children finish a tale that can save the building.

title: Ocean Mile
tagline: The swim crossed no finish line.
synopsis: Swimmer Elise Laurent attempts a cold-water route between the islands of Nerr and Tor to raise money for a rescue boat. The film follows her training, the volunteer pilots, and the fishing families who challenge the route's safety.

title: Kaze no Michi
synopsis: In coastal Iwato, conservator Mika Tanabe is hired to restore a map damaged by salt air. She follows its old walking route with musician Haru and learns the path was designed to bring separated neighbors home after storms.

title: Civic Holiday
synopsis: Town clerk Yuna Seo approves a one-day public holiday by checking the wrong box on a council form. When everyone in Bellport refuses to go back to work, she has to stage an emergency vote without admitting that the mayor is away fishing.

title: Vellum Kingdom
synopsis: An apprentice illustrator in Nareth discovers that painted borders are shrinking the kingdom each night. She enters a giant atlas to confront its lonely maker, who believes erasing roads will keep his daughter from leaving.

title: Marrow Field
tagline: The fence came after the graves.
synopsis: Ranch hand Anika Vale finds survey stakes driven through an old burial ground outside Marrow Field. She gathers testimony from the families who remember the site while a cattle company sends riders to move the markers overnight.

title: Vault Seven
synopsis: Security architect Alma Ruiz discovers a hidden seventh vault beneath the bank she designed in Grayson. When thieves take her brother hostage, she must guide them through her own defenses while quietly steering them toward the sealed evidence inside.

title: Canal Weather
synopsis: Architect Binta Diallo returns to Saint-Louis to assess a canal bridge slated for removal. An old friend who pilots the morning ferry challenges her report, and their arguments uncover a safer repair that could save his route.

title: Red Umbrella Club
synopsis: Nisha Rao enrolls in a rain-soaked neighborhood choir to escape her noisy apartment, only to discover it is a secret percussion society. Their first public show coincides with a council hearing about the building they rehearse in.

title: La Strada Stretta
synopsis: In Naples, courier Giulia Serra witnesses a council aide exchange a briefcase in a narrow lane moments before he is killed. She can identify the buyer, but her brother Marco's delivery van appears in every security image from the scene.

title: Feather Market
synopsis: At Bracken's annual bird fair, young Mina Cho accidentally releases a rare blue finch meant for the closing ceremony. She enlists a rival contestant and an impatient bus driver to find it before the mayor unveils an empty cage.

title: Lantern Bay: Low Tide
synopsis: After the lighthouse is saved, a low tide reveals a stone path leading from Lantern Bay to an uncharted wreck. Harbor clerk Sofia Vale and young deckhand Nari Choi follow Anika's old charts, then discover salvagers have already marked the wreck for demolition.

title: Pale Orbit
synopsis: On an aging orbital station, medic Priya Nair realizes the crew's sleep cycles are drifting because the habitat has begun to slow. She must persuade an engineer who falsified maintenance records to expose the fault before a supply craft docks.

title: The Island Ledger
synopsis: Researcher Hana Mori follows a century of handwritten ferry ledgers on the island of Treva. Interviews with island families reveal how seasonal workers kept the port running while official histories left them unnamed.

title: Do Kinare
synopsis: In the river town of Ratan, tailor Meera inherits a shop on the opposite bank from her family home. A bridge repair traps her there with reserved ferryman Arun, and the two organize neighbors to reopen the crossing before monsoon season.

title: The Mineral Room
synopsis: Geologist Ingrid Solberg brings an unusual mineral core from the quarry at Durn to her university laboratory. The samples swell whenever the lights go out, and the night custodian vanishes after hearing his own voice inside one of them.

title: The Ribbon Factory
tagline: A strike began with a color.
synopsis: Seamstress Aisha Qureshi takes a night job at the Lenton ribbon mill and discovers its new dyes are making workers sick. Her supervisor offers a promotion for silence, while her sister has already printed leaflets naming the owners.

title: Soft Landing
synopsis: Elise Laurent buys a tiny airfield outside Briar Glen thinking it is a flower nursery. She tries to convert the hangar into a greenhouse, but the local flight instructor keeps landing there with students and an increasingly elaborate excuse.

title: Die Letzte Fähre
synopsis: Near Hamburg, ferry dispatcher Mara Beck receives a final ticket for a route canceled years ago. She follows the passenger list to a warehouse where abandoned luggage is being cataloged under the names of living residents.

title: Skyline Gardeners
synopsis: Community organizer Rina Sato documents residents turning three neglected rooftops in Eastfield into shared gardens. Their work faces a setback when the property owner sells the buildings, prompting a campaign to protect the harvest and the tenants.

title: Firebreak Road
synopsis: Wildfire coordinator Salma Idrissi must evacuate the mountain hamlet of Keswick after a change in wind traps residents on the wrong side of a firebreak. A road crew working nearby can open a passage, but only if she risks sending them into the smoke.

title: Cedar Plain
synopsis: In Cedar Plain, Clara Weiss owns the only general store left after a railroad bypasses the settlement. When a survey team offers to move the station sign to her land, she discovers the deed would transfer the town's well to a distant investor.

title: Silver Circuit
synopsis: Detective Iris Bell investigates a jewelry theft in New Aster after security footage shows the stolen necklace walking out on a service robot. Its manufacturer blames a software fault, but an engineer finds a handwritten command hidden in the machine's route file.

title: Marrow Song
synopsis: After her mother's funeral in Aranda, Binta Diallo discovers a field recording of a song no one in the family admits to knowing. She follows its melody to a closed textile mill, where former workers remember the protest that changed the town.

title: Poppy and Iron
synopsis: In a city divided by a long ceasefire, young Poppy sends a windup iron bird across the barricade to find her missing brother. The toy passes from hand to hand, carrying a message neither side's commanders will allow through.

title: Hushwater
synopsis: At Hushwater Camp, caretaker Ada Venn hears children calling from a drained lakebed after the summer season ends. Her friend Miriam follows the voices into an old pumping station and finds a door wet on both sides.

title: The Ninth Door: Guestbook
synopsis: Six years after the Bellamy Hotel was sealed, archivist Lina Cho discovers a guestbook listing visitors who have not been born yet. She enters the building with a demolition surveyor, hoping to find Maeve Quinn's missing notes before the ninth room opens again.

title: Little Copper Town
synopsis: When a copper mine closes in the town of Elsen, student Nari Choi proposes using its siren tower as a community radio station. The mine manager objects until her first broadcast reunites workers scattered after the shutdown.

title: The Saffron Vote
synopsis: In the market town of Narol, vendor Priya Nair is nominated for council after joking that the mayor should tax stale bread. Her campaign gains momentum when she promises to settle a decades-old dispute over the public spice garden.

title: Beyond Juniper
synopsis: Scout Hana Mori leads a wagon of botanists beyond Juniper Ridge to locate a rare medicinal shrub. Their sponsor plans to fence the valley once they find it, so she must guide the plants' caretakers to the survey camp first.

title: Dead Letter Convoy
tagline: The mail carried a route home.
synopsis: During a border war, courier Samira Rahman finds letters addressed to soldiers officially listed as dead. She follows their regiment's abandoned supply route and discovers survivors being held to conceal a failed evacuation.

title: Small Hours Hotel
synopsis: Night manager Ingrid Solberg accidentally books a seaside hotel for two rival wedding parties on the same weekend. She assigns them alternating floors, but the couples keep meeting at the only working elevator.

title: Reef Keepers
synopsis: Marine ranger Ingrid Solberg joins fishers at Oru Reef to document a volunteer effort to restore storm-damaged coral shelves. Their work is interrupted by an illegal dredging crew, giving the camera a close view of the community's fight over its waters.

title: Morning Witness
tagline: The camera faced the wrong way.
synopsis: In Westbridge, courthouse photographer Mara Velez sees a defendant leave by a side door minutes before his recorded acquittal. Her negatives reveal that the person in court was a double, and the real man has her address.

title: Auburn Satellite
tagline: A message came from the wheat.
synopsis: Astronomer Noemi Costa discovers that a farm's irrigation system is transmitting an old satellite code every sunrise. Its owner wants the equipment shut off, but the signal may be the only record of a missing research mission.

title: Honeycomb Stairs
synopsis: Yuna Seo finds a staircase inside her aunt's attic that descends into a miniature village of beekeepers. When a cold snap threatens the colony, she brings their queen to the warm school greenhouse without letting her aunt see the tiny procession.

title: Sable Chorus
synopsis: Eva Lind takes a teaching post on Sable Island and finds the school choir has been canceled to fund a new seawall. She organizes a concert on the exposed beach, hoping the visiting officials will hear the children before signing the order.

title: El Puente Roto
synopsis: In the mountain town of Oliva, engineer Lucía discovers that the bridge she was hired to repair was deliberately damaged during a land dispute. She must persuade both sides to testify before the rainy season cuts off the valley.

title: Sundial Office
synopsis: A minor clerk in Orlo discovers that the office sundial moves backward whenever someone lies on a government form. Anika Mehta uses it to solve a missing-paycheck dispute, then learns the entire payroll is due for a mysterious revision.

title: Starling Run: Dark Beacon
synopsis: Years after freeing the shipping lanes, Samira Rahman discovers a beacon still sending false coordinates from an abandoned moon outpost. She takes Starling back into restricted space with Idris Noor, only to find survivors who depend on the signal to stay hidden.

title: The Pearl Index
synopsis: In Bellport, appraiser Iris Bell notices that pearls stolen from three homes were all once owned by the same diver. A retired auctioneer knows where they came from but will only speak after she recovers a missing ledger.

title: Bracken Bus
synopsis: Driver Elka Sabo takes her last bus run through Bracken, but the passengers refuse to let the service end quietly. They organize an impromptu parade of stops and accidentally deliver Councilman Vare to the neighborhood slated to lose transit.

title: Sous la Pluie
synopsis: In Lyon, pianist Céline is asked to accompany a children's choir outdoors despite a week of storms. She meets stage builder Étienne, whose temporary shelter becomes the only place in town where rehearsals can continue.

title: Cinder Watch
tagline: The fire never reached this floor.
synopsis: Night guard Maeve Collins patrols a rebuilt theater in Carrow where smoke appears in one balcony every evening. A box of tickets from the original fire bears tomorrow's date, and she finds four seats already reserved for the demolition crew.

title: Toward the Furnace
synopsis: During a siege of Loden, mechanic Leila Haddad leads civilians through an abandoned furnace complex to reach the river. An officer wants to destroy the plant to block enemy vehicles, but her sister is still searching its tunnels for trapped workers.

title: Winter Platform
tagline: The last train carried a vote.
synopsis: Union organizer Camille Moreau stays behind at the frosted Lorne station when management announces its closure. She persuades stranded passengers to testify about the line's importance before the council's morning meeting.

title: The Moth Engine
synopsis: In the floating city of Nacre, child inventor Hana Mori builds a moth-shaped engine to repair the failing night lamps. The device instead heads toward the dark side of the city's central tower, where an older power source has been hidden.

title: Seed Bank Heist
synopsis: Florist Lucia Ferraro plans to steal rare seeds from a private collection in Branton after the owner refuses to return them to local growers. Her team can crack the safe, but nobody has considered how to keep the seeds alive during the escape.

title: The Quiet Estuary
synopsis: Ecologist Samira Rahman investigates why migratory birds stopped visiting the Trenn estuary after a new channel was dredged. Fishermen, surveyors, and tide records point to a buried industrial pipe the operator insists was removed.

title: Dalbit Gil
synopsis: In Busan, photographer Minji returns to the hillside street where her parents first met and finds it marked for redevelopment. Sign painter Joon offers to help document its shops, but his family owns the company clearing them.

title: Ridgewater County
synopsis: Deputy Aisha Mir discovers that a new cattle route across Ridgewater County follows land secretly bought by the sheriff's cousin. She rides to warn the ranchers before a staged robbery provides a reason to seize their herds.

title: Cedar Comet
synopsis: At a summer camp near Cedar Lake, Elise Laurent finds a metal fragment that glows whenever the old observatory telescope points east. She convinces her skeptical counselor to follow its trail before the camp closes for the season.

title: Market After Dark
synopsis: Paramedic Ada Mensah responds to a call at the Wexley night market and finds every vendor has abandoned a still-warm stall. A security guard insists the market never opened, but a child is hiding beneath the fish counter.

title: Celestial Laundry
synopsis: Rina Sato inherits a laundry in Bellport where customers leave weather in their pockets. When a stranger brings in a coat full of falling stars, she and her brother must return them before the town's night sky goes blank.

title: The Alabaster Route
synopsis: Historian Salma Idrissi accompanies a survey team across the old Alabaster Route and finds mile markers that contradict official maps. A local guide reveals the markers were moved to hide a settlement erased after a failed mining venture.

title: Canal Tomorrow
synopsis: Engineer Clara Weiss returns to the canal village of Lowen after its lock system fails during a dry summer. Her niece Alma discovers a handwritten repair plan hidden in the town hall, but the council has already hired a contractor to fill the canal.

title: Quiet Gallows
synopsis: In the frontier town of Valen, deputy Iris Bell finds a signed execution order dated before the accused man's arrest. She follows the paper trail to a cattle syndicate whose debts depend on the prisoner's land.

title: Soundings
synopsis: Sound archivist Binta Diallo records ship horns and work songs at Saint-Louis harbor before the old docks close. Dockworkers help her reconstruct a call-and-response tradition that once guided boats through fog.

title: The Folded City
synopsis: Courier Jo Park discovers that entire streets in New Aster change positions while residents sleep. A transit planner believes a buried machine is reshaping the city, and Jo has until dawn to reach a hospital now cut off by a new wall.

title: Apricot Season
tagline: The fruit ripened all at once.
synopsis: Nisha Rao agrees to manage her uncle's orchard near Faro for a single summer and immediately books two harvest crews for the same week. She makes them compete for a contract, then realizes one crew leader has been secretly repairing the irrigation lines.

title: Cold Mosaic
synopsis: Restorer Amara Okoye uncovers a second image beneath a railway station mural in Lorne. It depicts a passenger whose disappearance was never reported, and the station's new owner orders the wall covered before she can photograph it.

title: Yuki no Tobira
synopsis: Near Nagano, Aiko inherits a garden gate that opens only during the first snowfall. She crosses it to meet a younger version of her grandfather Ren and must decide whether to warn him about a choice that shaped her family.

title: Amber Commission
synopsis: City auditor Nari Choi is assigned to review a tiny public-art grant in Eastmere. The invoices lead to a decade of missing repair funds, and her mentor asks her to withdraw the report before the mayor's retirement ceremony.

title: Aunties at Sea
synopsis: Priya Nair and her aunt Ilona win a weekend yacht trip, only to find the skipper has left for a family emergency. They try to sail home by following tourist maps while a stowaway wedding planner keeps changing their destination.

title: The Green Forge
synopsis: Apprentice Hana Mori is the only worker left at a village forge after its owner falls ill. She persuades a retired carpenter to help finish a bridge hinge before the autumn rains isolate the farms across the river.

title: Morrow Bridge
synopsis: Maintenance chief Zora Petrovic discovers a remote override on the Morrow Bridge just before a relief convoy reaches it. She and dispatcher Samira Rahman must disable the mechanism while a saboteur uses the traffic cameras to track their moves.

title: Fig Tree Hotel
synopsis: Ingrid Solberg agrees to run a half-finished hotel in Bergen while its owner recovers from an injury. A visiting architect keeps moving the opening date, so she starts renting rooms to festival performers and lets their rehearsals decide the layout.

title: Ghost Lanterns
synopsis: During restoration of an old harbor fort in Accra, conservator Laila Bako finds lanterns that ignite whenever a visitor repeats a soldier's name. She stops the excavation after one flame follows a worker home and burns through his locked door.

title: Pine and Paper
synopsis: Young Ivy plants a paper crane in the snow above the village of Carrow and wakes to find a pine tree covered in undelivered letters. She carries them downhill before spring melts the path to their recipients.

title: Briar Record
synopsis: Noemi Costa inherits an old community radio archive in Briar Glen and finds a caller predicting the closure of its hospital. The recording is twenty years old, and the voice belongs to a patient whose medical file was erased.

title: Late Harvest
synopsis: After a storm ruins the family vineyard near Porto, Yuna Seo arrives to help her estranged father salvage the late grapes. A neighboring grower offers equipment in exchange for a future partnership, forcing her to decide whether she will stay beyond harvest.

title: Outer Harbor
synopsis: Outside Rensby, ferry captain Eva Lind spots a metal hull beneath the shoals after an unusually low tide. Its compartments contain fresh supplies dated years in the future, and an approaching research ship claims it before she can call the coast guard.

title: The Bitter Acre
synopsis: Rancher Anika Mehta refuses to sell a narrow strip of land along a drought-struck valley. A cattle baron sends workers to divert its spring, and she recruits a traveling surveyor to prove the water rights before the next roundup.

title: Dusk Crossing
synopsis: Field doctor Alma Ruiz needs to move patients across the Dulce River before shelling resumes at dawn. A reluctant ferry operator will take one final crossing, leaving her to choose which equipment can be abandoned without costing lives.

title: Orchard Satellites
synopsis: Agronomist Nadia Karim works with growers near Cairo to compare satellite images against changes they can see in their orchards. Their findings expose a missing irrigation branch and challenge the official drought estimate used to allocate water.

title: Kestrel: Last Passage
synopsis: Ada Venn's original map is found beneath Calder's closed survey office as spring floods threaten White Ridge. Her former trainee Binta Diallo leads a new rescue team along the unmarked route, while a mining company tries to seal the pass first.

title: Thistle Hour
synopsis: At a seaside bookshop in Kells, owner Celeste Marin finds anonymous notes predicting which patrons will return overdue books. She and musician Nisha Rao suspect a prank until one note points to a missing violin inside the shop's locked attic.

title: Deepwater License
synopsis: Harbor inspector Maeve Collins finds forged diving permits after a salvage worker goes missing near Cork. The licenses lead to a wreck whose cargo was never declared, and the company managing the search controls the rescue boats.

title: A Taste of Rain
synopsis: Chef Leila Haddad returns to her aunt's café in Tunis after its roof is damaged by a rare storm. The roofer helping her rebuild keeps leaving recipes from his late mother, drawing her into a friendship neither has time for.

title: Brass and Bone
synopsis: Musician Nari Choi buys a battered horn from a Busan estate sale and hears an unseen audience applaud each time she plays. The applause grows closer after she performs a melody written on the case's lining.

title: Parcel for Tomorrow
synopsis: Priya Nair receives a parcel at her Kochi apartment containing a school drawing her daughter has not made yet. More deliveries reveal an impending bus accident, and she has to convince the driver without explaining how she knows.

title: The Ember Arch
synopsis: After a wildfire exposes a stone arch near Eastmere, botanist Hana Mori steps through and finds a valley where last year's plants are still alive. A private survey crew follows her, intent on taking seeds before the arch closes with the first rain.

title: Letters to Loden
synopsis: During a wartime evacuation, Samira Rahman keeps a mobile post office running between two camps outside Loden. She grows close to a doctor whose letters she cannot deliver because the recipient's village has vanished from the maps.

title: Tide Table
synopsis: Archivist Ingrid Solberg follows four families whose handwritten tide tables guided ships into North Haven for a century. Their notebooks reveal changes in the coast that official charts did not record until years later.

title: Ruby Carnival
synopsis: When a road closure strands the Ruby Carnival floats in a narrow Accra street, organizer Laila Bako moves the festival into neighboring courtyards. An officious inspector tries to issue fines until his own marching band gets trapped in the procession.

title: The Violet Fence
synopsis: At a community garden in Lahore, Aisha Qureshi notices a fence shifting inward by inches each week. A retired surveyor helps her trace the altered boundary to a land transfer signed by someone who died years ago.

title: Orbit Market
synopsis: Elise Laurent opens a pop-up market on a remote space station and accidentally sells the captain's emergency supplies as vintage collectibles. With a supply ship delayed, she must persuade customers to return their purchases without revealing why.

title: Moss and Mirrors
synopsis: Botanist Ada Mensah inspects a greenhouse in Kumasi where mirrors have begun fogging with images of plants that are not there. After a gardener follows a reflected path into the wall, Ada discovers a root system spreading behind the glass.

title: The Last Chorister
synopsis: Rina Sato returns to her childhood concert hall in Sapporo for its planned final performance. The aging conductor falls ill, leaving her to lead a choir whose youngest members have never sung together in person.

title: Copper Line: Ground Zero
synopsis: A demolition under Bracken Station exposes the original copper smuggling tunnel and evidence Vera Illich never found. New investigator Salma Idrissi follows Malik Noor's old case notes, then learns the transit authority has scheduled a concrete pour for dawn.

title: Hill Country Radio
synopsis: Broadcast engineer Clara Weiss visits villages around Szeged that maintain a shared low-power radio network. Listeners and volunteer hosts explain how local weather reports became a lifeline during severe floods.

title: Badlands Parcel
synopsis: Courier Iris Bell is hired to carry a sealed parcel across the Badlands to a judge who keeps changing towns. A boastful sheriff insists on escorting her, unaware that the package contains his own overdue tax records.

title: Slate Horizon
synopsis: Mountaineer Binta Diallo is hired to guide a mapping team above the Slate Horizon quarry. Their sponsor has hidden a drilling rig beyond the ridge, and Binta must get her crew down before the first blast triggers an avalanche.

title: Cloud Circus
synopsis: Young Jo Park chases her family's traveling circus after a gust lifts its tents into the sky over Cavan. A cloud shepherd offers to guide her upward if she can help gather his lost flock of storm birds first.

title: Velvet Invoice
synopsis: Accountant Nisha Rao finds a luxury theater's books full of charges for performances that never happened. She stages a fake opening night to draw out whoever has been collecting the money, only to discover the audience is entirely made of creditors.

title: Fogline
synopsis: Port pilot Ada Venn guides a medical ship toward Calder through dense fog after the navigation buoys go dark. An anonymous radio voice offers a shortcut, but the coordinates lead toward a reef that vanished from recent charts.

title: Paper Planet
synopsis: Mina Cho receives a paper globe that grows whenever she adds a drawing to its surface. Her brother fills it with dangerous mountains for fun, leaving Mina to redraw a safe path for the tiny travelers trapped inside.

title: The Pasture Deal
synopsis: Ranch accountant Nari Choi realizes her employer has sold the same herd to three buyers in Juniper County. She tries to warn the drovers before the auction, but the sheriff is owed a share of the fraudulent sale.

title: Blue Kitchen
synopsis: Priya Nair enters a neighborhood cooking contest in Kochi using her late aunt's incomplete recipe. Rival cook Arjun offers the missing page, but only if she helps him reopen the seaside café where they first met.

title: Hollow Ward
synopsis: In an abandoned hospital outside Kyoto, Hana Mori catalogs equipment for an auction and finds fresh patient charts on empty beds. A security guard insists the ward was demolished, even while its corridor lengthens behind them.

title: Lantern Bay: Open Water
synopsis: A new rescue beacon at Lantern Bay fails during a squall, leaving a school sailing boat beyond the reef. Anika's preserved charts help harbor pilot Zora Petrovic and young dispatcher Samira Rahman navigate the older lighthouse route in time.

title: After the Parade
synopsis: Talia Reed returns to Chicago to lead the marching band she abandoned as a teenager. Its rehearsal hall is being sold, and she must win back the students' trust before asking them to perform at a fundraiser.

title: Storm Records
synopsis: Meteorologist Laila Bako compares oral histories of the 1978 Accra floods with official storm records. Residents identify neighborhoods omitted from the maps, changing the route proposed for a new flood barrier.

title: Riverglass
synopsis: Mara Velez finds translucent stones along the Fenwick River that replay moments from her childhood when held to the light. She gathers them to understand her brother's departure, then notices each stone erases the same moment from someone else's memory.

title: The Night Orchard
synopsis: At a research orchard near Porto, Noemi Costa discovers that fruit harvested after dark contains images of places that do not yet exist. An investor wants the crop shipped immediately, but one image shows the packing house burning the next morning.

title: The Red Audit
synopsis: Accountant Yuna Seo reviews a hospital charity in Incheon after its founder vanishes before an annual gala. The donations are real, but every recipient address leads to a building demolished years ago.

title: Noon Harbor
synopsis: Ferry cook Eva Lind prepares a retirement feast for her captain, but a timetable error sends the boat to the wrong island. With no passengers aboard, she serves the meal to a stranded school orchestra and asks them to play their way home.

title: The Ninth Door: Ash Ledger
synopsis: When the Bellamy Hotel burns, an ash-covered ledger arrives at Anika Mehta's archive with her name entered as its next guest. She returns to the site with former guest Maeve Quinn and finds the ninth door standing alone above an intact staircase.

title: Dust and Cedar
synopsis: Surveyor Alma Ruiz arrives in Cedar Plain to mark a new freight road across communal grazing land. An elderly storekeeper produces a faded charter proving the land was never sold, forcing Alma to challenge the company paying her wages.

title: Aurora Farm
tagline: The sky came down to harvest.
synopsis: On a remote farm outside Glasgow, Iris Bell finds that her greenhouse windows capture the northern lights and release them at dawn. A visiting scientist offers to buy the glass, but Iris's daughter has begun using the light to guide lost hikers home.

title: The Wrong Castle
synopsis: Binta Diallo rents a country house for a quiet reunion, then discovers her cousins have arrived at a working historical reenactment castle. She tries to salvage the weekend while a rival family claims they booked the same banquet hall.

title: The Remaining Note
synopsis: After a concert hall closes in Dublin, cellist Jo Park discovers a missing final page in a score written for her teacher. A former rival has the page but refuses to hand it over until they perform the unfinished piece together.

title: Starling Run: Home Signal
synopsis: A generation after Starling exposed the false shipping lanes, a distress call reaches the courier from the hidden moon colony. New pilot Maeve Collins carries Samira's original coordinates through a blockade, while an aging navigator recognizes the signal as a warning about the colony's failing air supply.

title: Last House on Rill
synopsis: Leila Haddad visits the only house still standing after a flood in Rill Valley to collect her mother's belongings. The upstairs rooms are dry despite a collapsed roof, and each contains an object from a different family's evacuation.

title: Beyond the Breakwater
tagline: The old route found another shore.
synopsis: Marine cartographer Camille Moreau joins a small crew searching for the lost channel beyond Port Lune's breakwater. When the sea floor shifts after a storm, her charts become the only way to bring two fishing boats safely home.

title: Riverbend Assembly
synopsis: Council clerk Sofia Alvarez misplaces the agenda for Riverbend's emergency meeting and lets residents propose their own business. What begins as a debate over a bus shelter exposes a land sale the mayor hoped to approve without discussion.

title: Sable Light
synopsis: At Sable Point, lighthouse engineer Maeve Collins discovers that the restored beacon illuminates houses miles from the coast. Each lit window reveals a figure standing behind its residents, and the ferry has already left for the night.

title: The Broken Compass
synopsis: While camping near Marrow Lake, Nisha Rao finds a compass that points toward people who need help. She follows it with a skeptical park ranger and reaches a flooded trail before the rescue team receives its first call.

title: Garden of Small Fires
tagline: The lamps came back one by one.
synopsis: Historian Sofia Alvarez is hired to trace the old festival lantern route through Valparaiso. Electrician Mateo Rojas helps her restore the lamps, and their work reopens a family argument over why the celebration ended.

title: Stone Harbor
synopsis: Diver Maeve Collins finds a freshly cut stone marker beneath the water at Stone Harbor, miles from the nearest quarry. She and investigator Nisha Rao follow its serial number to a shipment scheduled to disappear before sunrise.
